import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"pony\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("actor Main\n  new create(env: Env) => None", config)
    println(result)
}
